import django
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(DEBUG=True, INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.messages'], MESSAGE_TAGS={})
django.setup()

from django.contrib.messages.storage.base import Message
from django.test import override_settings

# Default: level 29 has no tag
m = Message(29, 'x')
print('before override:', repr(m.level_tag))
assert m.level_tag == ''

with override_settings(MESSAGE_TAGS={29: 'custom'}):
    print('inside override:', repr(m.level_tag))
    assert m.level_tag == 'custom', 'BUG: LEVEL_TAGS not updated by override_settings'

print('after override:', repr(m.level_tag))
assert m.level_tag == ''
print('OK')
